svg.title: Same call, different NaN
svg.desc: Under -Xint all 2,000,000 calls returned the first NaN. Under the default JIT tiers 1,983,613 returned the first and 16,387 the second. One run each on a laptop, JDK 25.0.5.1 on x86-64.
